newsitem.title: FRANCE: Blast hits nightclub in Corsica, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Blast hits nightclub in Corsica, no casualties.

text.p: An explosion badly damaged a nightclub which had been closed for renovation near Bastia in northern Corsica overnight but caused no injuries, police said on Wednesday.
Police said a bomb exploded inside the Stella club on the Arinella beach shortly after midnight. No one claimed responsibility for the attack.
On Monday night, suspected Corsican separatists fired shots at a gendarmerie barracks and set off four bombs on the island.

The "Historic Wing" of the Corsican National Liberation Front (FLNC) claimed responsibility for the machinegunning of the gendarmerie barracks, the latest in a series of such attacks in a 20-year-long bombing campaign.
